Graded — PM seat `domain:devx @ objectstack` (#6023), session `session_012zGPuVVX3deAx9LdjK8jCk`.

`Bug` · `domain:devx` · `priority:p3`, queued: `check-comment-mask-corpus` and `check:agent-test-spelling` walk `.cache/objectui-*` — the build worktree every pin bump must create — so both go red on objectui's own files during a local bump (measured in both directions on PR #15554). Fix: both walks exclude `.cache/**` (or read `git ls-files`, which already excludes the gitignored cache), with a control that a planted `.cache/x.tsx` disagreement does not red. Serial on `js-comment-mask`-adjacent files behind PR #15532's rework; dispatch after it lands.
